additional_context: source/element.html was later folded into source/types.html by the abstract type framework refactor in cbdf7d1e55dc4bfa1dc30fc526edee0491e05782. Current source/fhir.ini maps the Element type page to types.html, and source/json.html illustrates complex datatype ids as "id" while using underscore only for primitive shadow properties. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scoped source already carries the FHIR-17723 correction, and the remaining current `_id` matches are unrelated search parameter, GraphQL, example, or primitive-shadow-property uses rather than the stale Element.id sentence.
